title: Choose the embedded area and toolchain
goal: Choose the embedded area and toolchain
acceptance: The owner picks the area (new core area embedded, coding with an embedded capability, or an extension area) and the compile toolchain for CI
The choice and date are recorded in the record
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Owner answer recorded in the record
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 in the domain-packs plan (owner request); owner time only.
